# /crav1-bundle-to-specs

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From intake files to specs](../../from-bundle-to-specs.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-bundle-to-specs/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Turn mixed intake (notes, diagrams, screenshots, optional code as context) into docs/system/ (including glossary.md) plus one spec slug per v0 feature.

Mixed intake → `docs/system/` (including `glossary.md`) + one spec per v0 feature (isolated slice workers). A missing `glossary.md` is filled when the folder already exists. New glossary rows are appended. Existing rows are not rewritten. A meaning the source does not state is `to be researched`. That same pass adds what is new to the short description, the diagram, and how the parts connect. It does not rewrite what is already there. On Azure Repos, one optional work-item question for the new slugs.

## Runs when

Mixed files, or several v0 features. Called by the user.

This is one of the six starter options. Asking for startup options names it and does not run it.

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 2 (the most prompts in one run, the closing yes included). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: The intake files.

Reads the intake files.

## Writes

In short: `docs/system/` with `glossary.md`, one spec per confirmed v0 feature, the landscape index, `work-item.md` on an Azure Repos opt-in, `docs/sources/` for an imported source, the transfer data policy after a yes, `Synced at`, and `Used by` on a quoted note.

Writes `docs/system/` including `glossary.md` (a missing glossary and new rows when the folder already exists), one `docs/specs/<slug>/` per confirmed v0 feature, the landscape index, `work-item.md` on an Azure Repos opt-in, and `docs/sources/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/` when an intake file it quotes is an imported source, following `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/sources.md`. That check may write the transfer data policy after a yes. Cursor: `.cursor/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.mdc`. Claude Code project: `.claude/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.md`. It never writes a secrets choice into that file. For a mail, it lists each embedded image, inline or attached. It recommends convert to text when the image is a diagram, a table, or text that can be reproduced exactly, and compress otherwise. It asks once before the source folder is written. Auto-accept applies to those recommendations only when the transfer data policy clearly covers them. Where it reads a whole repo, sets that repo's `Synced at` line in `repos.md` and touches only those repos. Where it reads only one slice, leaves the repos.md Synced at lines alone and writes or updates `Synced at: <repo> <branch>@<short sha>, <date>` on that slice's `spec.md`.

## Does not

Leaves application code, `plan.md`, and later slices alone. Does not commit.

Limits and exceptions: prompts [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md) and does not run it. A quoted note in `docs/notes/` gets its slug in `used_by` and a `Full source:` link; notes are never absorbed (1.61.0).
